say:0:1423148001:0.text: Are Hugin and Zanie still chatting? Wait... are they having an argument?!
say:0:1423148001:0.source_cn: 呼金和祖娅还在聊天吗？他们怎么……吵起来了？！
say:0:1423148001:0.male: Are Hugin and Zanie still chatting? Wait... are they having an argument?!
say:0:1423148001:0.female: Are Hugin and Zanie still chatting? Wait... are they having an argument?!

say:2:1423150001:0.text: Ah, aren't you just the perfect disciple? The moment you're back, you start challenging me.
say:2:1423150001:0.source_cn: 唉，我这个徒弟啊……一回来就跟我唱反调。

say:3:1423150002:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you hear me out and tell me what you think?
say:3:1423150002:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you hear me out and tell me what you think?
say:3:1423150002:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you hear me out and tell me what you think?

say:4:1423150003:1.text: I think there's a serious flaw in Master Zanie's plan.
say:4:1423150003:1.source_cn: 我觉得祖娅老师的魔钢研究方案有不可忽视的问题。

choice_prompt:5:1423150003.text: I think there's a serious flaw in Master Zanie's plan.
choice_prompt:5:1423150003.source_cn: 我觉得祖娅老师的魔钢研究方案有不可忽视的问题。

say:6:1423150004:1.text: The problem lies with manual labor. There's no way to ensure consistent magic infusion, not even for a couple of celestrites, let alone an entire batch.
say:6:1423150004:1.source_cn: 如果依靠人工给矿石注入魔力的话，完全无法保证注入的程度...

say:7:1423150005:1.text: In other words, we can't guarantee the quality of the raw materials.
say:7:1423150005:1.source_cn: 也就是说，完全无法保证武器原材料的品质！

say:8:1423150006:1.text: That's a shame, especially since we take pride in producing weapons with consistent quality—it's how we used to land orders from clients who valued it.
say:8:1423150006:1.source_cn: 但是深岩村的生产线最自豪的就是能保证武器的品质一致，所...

say:9:1423150007:1.text: What's the point of making a profit if we're sacrificing quality? That'll wreck our reputation!
say:9:1423150007:1.source_cn: 这样村里的生产是恢复了，可村子的金字招牌也要砸了！

say:10:1423150008:1.text: I get what you're saying, but it's not something we can't fix! We just need to tighten the quality checks!
say:10:1423150008:1.source_cn: 你说的这种情况是有发生的可能，可到时候加派几道人手，加...

say:11:1423150009:1.text: We still don't fully understand how magic affects the celestrite's properties at this point...
say:11:1423150009:1.source_cn: 我们现在甚至对魔力影响矿石性质的原理都不清不楚……

say:12:1423150010:1.text: To conduct a proper study, we'll need more samples...
say:12:1423150010:1.source_cn: 这得有了足够的样品量，才能慢慢研究……

say:13:1423150011:1.text: Since Hugin has pointed out the issue, I can't just turn a blind eye to it.
say:13:1423150011:1.source_cn: 好吧，既然呼金指出了方案的问题，我总不能装作什么都没听见。

say:14:1423150012:1.text: Some Sal'thorin priests are already doing the enchanting work. Let's check on them.
say:14:1423150012:1.source_cn: 萨洛克兰已经派了几位祭司进行给矿石注魔的工作了，我们去...

say:0:1423151001:0.text: Ironbeard, how are things coming along?
say:0:1423151001:0.source_cn: 铁须，注魔的情况怎么样了？

say:2:1423153001:0.text: Ironbeard, how are things going on your side?
say:2:1423153001:0.source_cn: 铁须，现在矿石注魔和魔钢冶炼的情况怎么样了？

say:4:1423153003:1.text: I should have just left the village... Now that the contract's been signed, there's no turning back...
say:4:1423153003:1.source_cn: 我早就觉得什么注魔不靠谱，就该拉着大伙一起走的……现在...

say:5:1423153004:1.text: You can rant all you want, but first, tell me what's wrong!

say:6:1423153005:1.text: Take a look at these azuresteel ingots yourselves! Most of them don't meet the standards!
say:6:1423153005:1.source_cn: 我这放着冶炼所刚锻打出来的蓝魔钢锭，正要退给这些尖耳朵...

say:1:1423154001:1.text: With a defect rate this high, we'll lose everyone's trust!
say:1:1423154001:1.source_cn: 你们看看！合格率这么低，要怎么跟大伙交待！

say:2:1423154002:1.text: I'll figure something out. For now, let's make use of those that turned out fine.
say:2:1423154002:1.source_cn: 我再想想办法，先把质量合格的魔钢投进生产线……

say:3:1423154003:1.text: ...Sorry, but I'm out. Zanie, call off the deal as soon as you can so we can all go.
say:3:1423154003:1.source_cn: ……恕我不奉陪了。幸好签的协议只是第一期，祖娅，你尽快...

say:4:1423154004:1.text: Everyone, drop what you're doing! We're heading back to the village!
say:4:1423154004:1.source_cn: 大伙们，把手里的活停下吧，我们回村去！

say:7:1423154006:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think I'm doing this wrong? It feels like the odds are stacked against me.
say:7:1423154006:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think I'm doing this wrong? It feels like the odds are stacked against me.
say:7:1423154006:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think I'm doing this wrong? It feels like the odds are stacked against me.

say:8:1423154007:1.text: Never mind, I shouldn't bother you with my problems. I'll sort it out myself.
say:8:1423154007:1.source_cn: 算了，这些事不该来烦你，我一个人考虑考虑吧。
say:8:1423154007:1.male: Never mind, I shouldn't bother you with my problems. I'll sort it out myself.
say:8:1423154007:1.female: Never mind, I shouldn't bother you with my problems. I'll sort it out myself.

narration:11:1423154009:0.text:
Zanie strides off, lost in thought.
Night falls, but Zanie is nowhere to be seen...
narration:11:1423154009:0.source_cn: 祖娅沉思着独自离开了。\n一直到晚上，她都没有出现……

narration:12:1423154010:0.text: Worried about Zanie, you decide to find her and have a chat.
narration:12:1423154010:0.source_cn: 不放心祖娅的情况，你决定找到她，跟她聊聊
narration:12:1423154010:0.male: Worried about Zanie, you decide to find her and have a chat.
narration:12:1423154010:0.female: Worried about Zanie, you decide to find her and have a chat.

say:0:1423155001:0.text: Zanie's not in the village... Could she have gone out?
say:0:1423155001:0.source_cn: 祖娅不在村里……难道是去了村子外面？
say:0:1423155001:0.male: Zanie's not in the village... Could she have gone out?
say:0:1423155001:0.female: Zanie's not in the village... Could she have gone out?

say:2:1423156002:0.text: Don't worry about me. I just need a drink to blow off some steam.
say:2:1423156002:0.source_cn: 别担心了，我就是遇到瓶颈了，一个人在这儿喝喝啤酒，散散心。

say:3:1423156003:1.text: Be honest with me—do you think this arcane steel project is doomed?
say:3:1423156003:1.source_cn: 在你看来，你觉得魔钢研究真的行不通吗？
say:3:1423156003:1.male: Be honest with me—do you think this arcane steel project is doomed?
say:3:1423156003:1.female: Be honest with me—do you think this arcane steel project is doomed?

choice_prompt:4:1423156003.text: Be honest with me—do you think this arcane steel project is doomed?
choice_prompt:4:1423156003.source_cn: 在你看来，你觉得魔钢研究真的行不通吗？
choice_prompt:4:1423156003.male: Be honest with me—do you think this arcane steel project is doomed?
choice_prompt:4:1423156003.female: Be honest with me—do you think this arcane steel project is doomed?

say:5:1423156004:1.text: I hope so too, but I don't think we can ever overcome this technical issue...
say:5:1423156004:1.source_cn: 我也是这么希望的，可是现在眼前的技术难题就无法解决啊……

say:8:1423156007:1.text: You're right! I've been stressed out for way too long. Today, I'm just going to kick back and relax!
say:8:1423156007:1.source_cn: 你说的对！我已经被这些糟心事烦了太久了，今天我要痛痛快...
say:8:1423156007:1.male: You're right! I've been stressed out for way too long. Today, I'm just going to kick back and relax!
say:8:1423156007:1.female: You're right! I've been stressed out for way too long. Today, I'm just going to kick back and relax!

say:10:1423156005:1.text: ...I knew it. If this project had any real chance, I wouldn't be stuck here brooding by myself.
say:10:1423156005:1.source_cn: ……是啊。如果行得通的话，我现在也不会在这儿了吧。

say:2:1423158002:1.text: When I dropped the beer bottle, it made these huge ripples on the surface...
say:2:1423158002:1.source_cn: 啤酒瓶掉进湖里……好大的……波纹……

say:3:1423158003:1.text: Ripples... Could magic be flowing through the ore like ripples? Haha, what nonsense am I rambling about...
say:3:1423158003:1.source_cn: 波纹……魔力在矿石中流动，会不会也是一种波纹呢……哈哈...

say:4:1423158004:1.text: Wait, that actually makes sense! If magic moves like ripples, maybe that explains...
say:4:1423158004:1.source_cn: 对了，波纹！如果是波纹的话，说不定可以解释……

say:5:1423158005:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I've got to run. Catch you later!
say:5:1423158005:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I've got to run. Catch you later!
say:5:1423158005:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I've got to run. Catch you later!

say:0:1423159001:0.text: Is Zanie feeling better now? I'd better check on her.
say:0:1423159001:0.source_cn: 不知道祖娅的心情好点没，去看看她吧。
say:0:1423159001:0.male: Is Zanie feeling better now? I'd better check on her.
say:0:1423159001:0.female: Is Zanie feeling better now? I'd better check on her.

say:1:1423161001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you happen to know where Master Zanie is?
say:1:1423161001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you happen to know where Master Zanie is?
say:1:1423161001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you happen to know where Master Zanie is?

say:3:1423161002:0.text: Are you guys looking for Zanie? She just asked me to bring her some enchanted celestrites. She's at the smelting workshop now.
say:3:1423161002:0.source_cn: 哎，你们找祖娅吗？她刚刚让我给她拿些注魔的矿石过去，人...

say:4:1423161003:1.text: Let's head over there now! I need to speak with her about something important!
say:4:1423161003:1.source_cn: 我们赶快过去吧，我有重要的事找她！

say:0:1423162001:0.text: Master Zanie, I need to talk to you!
say:0:1423162001:0.source_cn: 祖娅老师，我有重要的事找你！

say:2:1423164001:1.text: Master Zanie, I've come up with a solution!
say:2:1423164001:1.source_cn: 祖娅老师，我想到解决问题的办法了！

say:3:1423164002:1.text: Since the magic is unevenly spread in the celestrites, we just need to find a way to even it out!
say:3:1423164002:1.source_cn: 既然魔力在矿石中分布不均，那我们想办法让它均匀起来不就...

say:4:1423164003:1.text: Yesterday, I pored over some ancient texts on arcane steel and examined the enchanted celestrites. I noticed a pattern in the magic!
say:4:1423164003:1.source_cn: 我昨天翻了帝国时期魔钢研究的记录，又检查了半天注入了魔...

say:5:1423164004:1.text: It looks just like water ripples! The magic's stronger on the outside of the ore and weaker inside!
say:5:1423164004:1.source_cn: 简单来说，就像水波一样！矿石外层魔力强，内层魔力弱！

say:6:1423164005:0.text: I've laid out my solution in this proposal. I haven't covered everything, but it's solid enough to move forward!
say:6:1423164005:0.source_cn: 解决方法你直接看我写的这份研究计划吧！虽然还有些地方不...

Magic Homogenizer (a.k.a. Spindora!)

Method:
Control the flow and diffusion of magic within ore by emulating the ripple effect of water.
Ensure magic disperses evenly within the ore by creating specific oscillations with varying parameters. The uniform distribution of magic within the ore effectively resolves the issue of structural instability.

Note: Different ores may require different wave frequencies and amplitudes! Using the appropriate oscillation is essential to ensure uniform dispersion.

矿用魔力均质器（暂用名，小漩涡！）

say:8:1423164006:0.text: Nice work, Hugin! I'm so proud of you!
say:8:1423164006:0.source_cn: 不错嘛，呼金，不愧是我的好徒弟！

say:9:1423164007:1.text: That's the way we dwarves deal with problems!
say:9:1423164007:1.source_cn: 这才是我们矮人面对问题的态度！

say:10:1423164008:1.text: Still, it's too bad you're a step behind.
say:10:1423164008:1.source_cn: 可惜，你个年轻人手脚也太慢了，还是晚了一步啊。

choice_prompt:11:1423164008.text: Still, it's too bad you're a step behind.
choice_prompt:11:1423164008.source_cn: 可惜，你个年轻人手脚也太慢了，还是晚了一步啊。

say:12:1423164009:1.text: I must thank <style="stress"><player_name></style>, who told me to take a break yesterday. When I tossed a beer bottle into the lake and watched the ripples spread, an idea similar to yours hit me...
say:12:1423164009:1.male: I must thank <style="stress"><player_name></style>, who told me to take a break yesterday. When I tossed a beer bottle into the lake and watched the ripples spread, an idea similar to yours hit me...
say:12:1423164009:1.female: I must thank <style="stress"><player_name></style>, who told me to take a break yesterday. When I tossed a beer bottle into the lake and watched the ripples spread, an idea similar to yours hit me...

say:13:1423164010:1.text: So, I pulled an all-nighter and built this <style="highlight">magic homogenizer</style>!
say:13:1423164010:1.source_cn: 所以我就熬了个大夜，哈哈！<style=highlig...

say:14:1423164011:1.text: I already gave it a test run just now!
say:14:1423164011:1.source_cn: 刚刚，我已经试用了一次了！

say:15:1423164012:1.text: And this little gadget here is an <style="highlight">overclocked magic comparator</style>, which keeps the magic consistent across different batches of celestrites. With this, the whole process is foolproof!
say:15:1423164012:1.source_cn: 如果要确保不同批次的原料魔力一致，还可以用这个<sty...

say:16:1423164013:1.text: I still have a lot to learn from you, Master Zanie...

say:18:1423164014:1.text: Talk is cheap. If you want to convince me, prove those fancy gadgets actually work!
say:18:1423164014:1.source_cn: 别说这些口头上的了！你发明的那玩意既然那么厉害，让我们...

say:19:1423164015:1.text: These azuresteel ingots are hot off the forge. Let's see how they hold up.
say:19:1423164015:1.source_cn: 那就看看冶炼所新出的这批蓝魔钢锭合格率怎么样吧。

say:2:1423165001:0.text: There are still some duds, but the defect rate is much lower than before!
say:2:1423165001:0.source_cn: 虽然还是有一些不合格的蓝魔钢锭，但次品率大大降低了！

say:3:1423165002:1.text: With a bit more tweaking, the defect rate could be even lower.
say:3:1423165002:1.source_cn: 要是再调整调整参数，次品率还能降到更低！

say:5:1423165004:1.text: You're not too bad yourself, Hugin!

say:6:1423165005:1.text: Ironbeard's been quiet so far. Let's get his take.
say:6:1423165005:1.source_cn: 铁须这家伙一直没说话，也没表态，我们去问问他是怎么想的。

say:2:1423166001:0.text: So, Ironbeard, you ready to stay in the village for good now?
say:2:1423166001:0.source_cn: 怎么样，铁须，现在你有信心继续待在村子了吗？

say:3:1423166002:1.text: I... truly respect your dedication... Maybe I was too set in my ways.
say:3:1423166002:1.source_cn: 既然你都做到这个份上了……我实在佩服。是我固执己见了。

say:4:1423166003:1.text: All these days, I've been dodging responsibility with excuses, and you guys have been out there, actually saving the village.
say:4:1423166003:1.source_cn: 这些日子里，面对村里的烂摊子，一直找借口推诿逃避的是我...

say:5:1423166004:1.text: With this breakthrough of yours, I don't need to say much. It's enough to convince everyone to stay.
say:5:1423166004:1.source_cn: 看到这样的成果，不用我多说，村里的大伙也会主动留下，踏...

say:6:1423166005:1.text: Don't mind my attitude before this, Zanie! From now on, I'll be the first to step up if you need help!
say:6:1423166005:1.source_cn: 之前那些事，对不住啦！以后祖娅你让我出力，我绝对说一不二！

say:7:1423166006:1.text: Feels strange hearing you talk so nicely to me, Ironbeard!
say:7:1423166006:1.source_cn: 铁须突然变得这么客气还真不有点不习惯！

say:8:1423166007:1.text: Well, we've worked our socks off these days. Didn't even get around to welcoming Hugin back properly.
say:8:1423166007:1.source_cn: 好啦！为了魔钢的事，大家也忙了好多天了，连呼金回村都没...

say:9:1423166008:1.text: Now that we've finally made some progress, I say we call it a day and throw a feast for Hugin!
say:9:1423166008:1.source_cn: 好在魔钢的事有些眉目了，我做主，今天给大伙放个假，一起...
